issues.description: The numeric conversion function fix_fix2float is declared/defined with inconsistent return types across artifacts: the example program defines it as returning float, while the test helper header in the template repository defines/implements it as returning double. The solution repository uses float consistently. This mismatch (same identifier, different return types) can confuse students reading tests and example code and may lead to subtle type/precision misunderstandings when mapping the example implementation to the tests.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of fix_fix2float consistent across artifacts. Change tests/src/math_fix.h in the template repository to declare/implement fix_fix2float as float (matching example_program/src/math_fix.c and the solution), or alternatively change the example program to use double everywhere. Prefer aligning tests to the example/solution (float) to avoid type mismatches and reduce student confusion.
